Keychat 1.0.0 initial release

- Adds easy installation of Keychat for OpenClaw agents.
- Enables E2E encrypted messaging powered by Signal Protocol over Nostr relays.
- Supports macOS (ARM/x64) and Linux (x64/ARM64).
- Automatically generates a Nostr identity and shares connection details (npub, link, QR code) after install.
- Advises expected security warnings during install for transparency.
